senses.definition: Largely or seemingly free of signs and symptoms, yet nonetheless with some aspect or appearance of illness, especially if ineffably.

senses.example: An investigative reporter we know always talks about the JDLR factor— if it Just Doesn't Look Right, it's probably not.

senses.definition: A title for a lay leader who has not been ordained as a pastor, particularly a youth group leader.
senses.example: Through Pyon JDSN, whose love for the young souls is ardent, our youths' souls will be revived.
